text:
leo: FYI onboarding smoke failing intermittently on embed+rerank. Error shows vector len mismatch and sometimes duplicate rerank entries.

marie: can you paste the error and the request payload?

leo: server log: 
``n{"error":"bad_request","message":"expected dim=1536 but item[2] len=1528"}
``nrequest (from devtools):
``n{ "vectors": [ [0.12,0.34,...,0.0 /* trimmed */], [0.98,0.01,...] ], "query": "best onboarding steps" }
``n
tess: sounds like two problems: 1) our sampleapp uses top-level `vectors` vs runtime's `items:[{id,vector}]`, 2) SDK/browser serialization is stripping trailing zeros to reduce payload size. That breaks the batch index <-> id mapping and triggers retry duplication.

marie: repro steps: clone sampleapp, yarn, start, run 'onboard content' flow -> watch POST /v1/rerank fail with 400.

leo: quick local hack I used: normalize before send -> convert vectors -> items with ids and pad to 1536. snippet:
``nfunction normalize(body){ const items = (body.vectors||[]).map((v,i)=>({id:`i${i}`,vector: padTo(v,1536)})); return {items, query: body.query} }
``n
marie: SDK team: can we please stop compacting arrays by default? We need a parity flag across py/js/rust and an option to auto-pad or fail fast.

sdk-ci: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/300 - "preserve trailing zeros + padVectors option". Added unit tests for node/browser.

tess: runtime UX ask: when dims mismatch emit a helpful header or error text like "expected=1536 got=1528; check client trimming/padding" so teams debug faster.

runtime-bot: filed internal runtime ticket RN-442: "Improve vector-dim mismatch diagnostics".

leo: leaving this here. will merge sampleapp middleware until SDK patch ships. thanks! :thumbsup:
